Chapter 1425 - 7: Is That The Galaxy?

Chapter 1425 - 7: Is That the Galaxy?

In the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan looked at the small mountain made entirely of the sands of time before him.

The sands of time are formed by the convergence of the most essential forces of time, which can be divided or fused together.

In order to smoothly move the Time Mountain out of the Wanwei space-time, Lin Yuan divided it into seven million parts.

When these seven million parts gather together again, they can once again fuse into the Time Mountain.

"No wonder beings of time love exploration so much."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan's face; just relying on seclusion and hard cultivation cannot accumulate so much sands of time.

If he hadn't dispatched the Taiji Primordial Spirit into the Wanwei space-time, how many years would it take to accumulate such a large amount of sands of time?

"This time entering the Wanwei space-time can be considered a complete success."

Lin Yuan thought to himself. Originally, he only planned to harvest a few thousand to ten thousand catties of sands of time.

As a result, he obtained a small mountain worth seven to eight million catties of sands of time, which naturally left him very satisfied.

"Next, I can let the Taiji Primordial Spirit explore a little deeper."

Lin Yuan thought in his heart.

With such a large Time Mountain harvest, even if his current Taiji Primordial Spirit were to fall immediately, he wouldn't feel any distress.

And by exchanging blows with the Bald Time Lord, Lin Yuan also confirmed his strength range, standing as an extremely powerful second-tier lord.

With this level of strength, even venturing deep into the Wanwei space-time, as long as he is careful, he won't encounter much danger.

Even when facing those legendary tier Time Lords, at worst, he would lose a main battle body, not affecting his other true bodies.

As his strength increases and with enough harvest, Lin Yuan doesn't mind taking some risks.

If he fails, he would only lose one Taiji Primordial Spirit.

Should he gain something deeper in the Wanwei space-time, even if it's not as great as this Time Mountain, it would far exceed slowly exploring the perimeter areas.

"With my current strength, I can be more assertive even in the depths of the Wanwei space-time, without needing to be so timid."

Lin Yuan thought secretly.

Legendary tier lords are exceedingly rare, and according to Lin Yuan's current strength, under a legendary tier lord, even if he isn't a match, he can retreat unscathed.

Those second-tier lords who have already touched the legend threshold and are crossing the last eight thousand tribulations might find it easy to repel Lin Yuan, but to suppress him... even if they have that ability, they wouldn't use it.

Because it's too time-consuming, just as Lin Yuan is unwilling to pursue the Bald Time Lord, those who have touched the legend threshold are also unwilling to chase Lin Yuan.

The Wanwei space-time has only opened for a few million years, time is precious, and the Time Lords are all quite rational.

As for those at the third-tier legend level... if he truly encountered one, Lin Yuan would directly choose to extinguish that Taiji Primordial Spirit.

Absolutely not giving the legendary tier lord any chance to directly strike at him.

...

"Finally, I can head to Green Cliff Mountain to purchase a batch of needed resources."

Lin Yuan put away the Time Mountain and pondered with a thoughtful expression.

With such a large batch of sands of time obtained, the first thing is naturally to quickly convert it into his own strength.

Thinking of this, the past self residing in the past time-space immediately headed to the place where the Time Lords communicate, 'Green Cliff Mountain.'

Upon entering Green Cliff Mountain, Lin Yuan noticed that the avatars of the lords here were much more numerous than usual.

There was even a slightly 'lively' atmosphere.

"It should be due to the opening of the Wanwei space-time."

Lin Yuan was not much surprised. The opening of the Wanwei space-time is a 'grand event' in this vast dimensional gap area.

Lords who hadn't shown up for ages would all head there, and being in the Wanwei space-time, the need for lords to exchange information greatly increases, so naturally, they would choose to enter Green Cliff Mountain to communicate.

"It's just... even with the vast fame of the 'Wanwei space-time' to such a degree, those origin worlds I descended upon have never heard of it..."

Lin Yuan's expression showed slight confusion.

Near the dimensional gap area where the Chaos Void was located, those with a bit of strength among time beings knew of the existence of the Wanwei space-time.

However, the first origin world, the second origin world, and the third origin world sitting in the dimensional gap area had not heard of Wanwei space-time.

"The vast dimensional gap is too immense."

Lin Yuan marveled in his heart, concluding that the distance between the two sides was too far.

Even legendary tier Time Lords have not yet explored the true size of the vast dimensional gap.

And there are numerous time-space layers existing between different dimensional spaces, so the distance between them is not simply a matter of spatial distance.

Perhaps the several origin worlds Lin Yuan travels through were not on the same timeline as the Chaos Void.

This could also explain why the dimensional gap regions where the origin worlds are located have never heard of Wanwei space-time.

...

Time-Space Shop.

As Lin Yuan just walked in, a twelve-eyed beast greeted him warmly.

"I didn't expect to see you again so soon." The twelve-eyed beast clearly had a strong impression of Lin Yuan.

"I'm here to purchase some resources." Lin Yuan said directly.

"Please take a look." The twelve-eyed beast flipped its hand, and multiple light screens appeared before Lin Yuan's eyes.

"This one, this one, and this one too."

Lin Yuan selected dozens of raw materials and precious resources, worth two to three hundred thousand catties of sands of time.

"It seems you've had great gains within the Wanwei space-time..." The twelve-eyed beast looked surprised.

Two to three hundred thousand catties of sands of time are not something a newly-promoted Time Lord can produce.

Even many second-tier Time Lords may not be able to take out such an amount of sands of time at once, as the wealth of Time Lords is usually concentrated in their weapons and treasures, and not necessarily in the liquidity of sands of time.
